title: smtp/server.rs credential building: nested match instead of ? with map_err
description: crates/smtp/src/server.rs builds the credential store with nested match blocks (match secret_store.get().await { Ok(v) => v, Err(e) => return Err(format!(...)) }) for each secretx step. The imap and reader equivalents use ? propagation with From<CredentialStoreError> via BuildStoreError. The smtp version is harder to read and harder to extend. Refactor smtp to use the same BuildStoreError pattern and ? propagation — this naturally resolves the duplication finding stoa-44ba837b.1.
